Title: Some questions on Form of Mist (LSJ)

Messages.Author: Tetragrammaton
Messages.Body:
Hy, just to clear my mind:

Vamp A is acting,
Vamp B is tapped,
but plays a forced awakening (or a Wake with the evening
freshness) attempting to block.

Vamp A adds an action modifier (say, inferior Earth Control), going at +1
stealth.

Vamp B plays a reaction (say, a Precognition) getting +1 intercept and
succesfully blocks vamp A.

In the following combat, vamp A plays a superior Form of Mist continuing the
action,

Is the previously-played Forced Awakening (or WwEF)
by vamp B still "active" ?

And so vamp B (tapped) can still attempt to block
the continuing-acting vamp A ?

More, is the previously-played Precognition still-in-effect, and so vamp B
has *still*
the +1 intercept for blocking vamp A ?

More:
vamp X acts, bleeding.
vamp Y (untapped) blocks vamp X.
Combat:
vamp X plays a Form of Mist, continuing the action.

At this point,
can vamp Y play a Cat's Guidance (or a Guard Dogs / Rat's Warning) ?

Many thanks in advance

Emiliano, vekn prince of Rome

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Tetragrammaton wrote:
> Vamp A is acting,
> Vamp B is tapped,
> but plays a forced awakening (or a Wake with the evening
> freshness) attempting to block.
>
> Vamp A adds an action modifier (say, inferior Earth Control), going at +1
> stealth.
>
> Vamp B plays a reaction (say, a Precognition) getting +1 intercept and
> succesfully blocks vamp A.
>
> In the following combat, vamp A plays a superior Form of Mist continuing the
> action,
>
> Is the previously-played Forced Awakening (or WwEF)
> by vamp B still "active" ?

Yes. It is the same action. All action modifiers and reaction cards apply for
the duration of the action by default.

>
> And so vamp B (tapped) can still attempt to block
> the continuing-acting vamp A ?

Yes.

> More, is the previously-played Precognition still-in-effect, and so vamp B
> has *still*
> the +1 intercept for blocking vamp A ?

Yes.

>
> More:
> vamp X acts, bleeding.
> vamp Y (untapped) blocks vamp X.
> Combat:
> vamp X plays a Form of Mist, continuing the action.
>
> At this point,
> can vamp Y play a Cat's Guidance (or a Guard Dogs / Rat's Warning) ?

Yes.
